needed.suggestion: Install a dedicated, at least 1.5m wide sidewalk along the right side to ensure safe pedestrian movement.
Remove parked vehicles or obstacles blocking the footway on the left side to allow clear pedestrian passage.
Repair uneven sections on the right-side footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing is poorly visible and obstructed
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island and enhance visibility with high-contrast markings at the crossing to reduce crossing risk.

needed.evidence: Dropped kerbs are absent at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the marked crossing to ensure smooth and safe pedestrian transitions for those with mobility issues.
